title.zh: 设置白板应用回调地址

descriptions.zh:
# 使用说明

- 调用本接口前，您必须已经调用[CreateApp](~~204234~~)创建白板应用。
- 目前互动白板控制台还未正式上线，请通过互动白板服务端SDK进行白板应用的相关操作。

# QPS限制
本接口的单用户QPS限制为100次/秒。超过限制，API调用会被限流，这可能会影响您的业务，请合理调用。更多信息，请参见[QPS限制](~~342798~~)。
descriptions.en:
# Usage notes

- Before invoking this operation, you must have already created a whiteboard application by calling [CreateApp](~~204234~~).
- The Interactive Whiteboard console is not yet officially online. Use the Interactive Whiteboard server SDK to perform related operations on whiteboard applications.

# QPS limit
The single-user QPS limit for this operation is 100 calls per second. If the limit is exceeded, API calls are throttled, which may affect your business. Invoke this operation appropriately. For more information, see [QPS limit](~~342798~~).
